about: A notebook from disk that the user asks to open and run, whose cells take 20 s. However the agent starts the first run (open_notebook with run_notebook, #331, or allow_execution after a safe-preview open, #170), a read right after it waits for that run, so the agent reports the value without polling or running the cells again. The soft check says which way it went. Tags: open_notebook run_notebook, allow_execution, read_cell wait, running twice.
